exposure: adrenocorticotropic hormone (tetracosactide depot) combined with vigabatrin
cohort: The study included 39 patients with West syndrome from two specialized centers, aged 2 to 120 months, who had failed primary treatment.
finding: Combined therapy of adrenocorticotropic hormone and vigabatrin demonstrated favorable efficacy in achieving clinical and electroencephalographic remission but was associated with significant seizure relapse rates in the medium term.
